firmware.status: shared official image; there is no M12-specific M5Burner UIFlow2 entry
firmware.name: UIFlow2.0 AtomS3R-CAM
firmware.evidence_sha256_match: downloaded by M5Burner public metadata; sha256 matches the image already used for the AtomS3R-CAM evidence

patch_apply_checks: git apply --reverse --check in the fix tree
pristine 6961d82 (0112) + 0113..0120 in native order, then git apply --check 0122 => clean

implementation.machine: m5atoms3rm12 reuses the AtomS3R-CAM controller/panel/PSRAM/LCD_CAM/dedicated SCCB bridge
implementation.inventory: BMM150 0x10, BMI270 0x68, OV3660 0x3c on the shared bus; the AtomS3R-CAM-only LP5562/ES8311/PI4IOE models are not part of this board
implementation.ov3660_model: 16-bit SCCB register space (write: addr high, addr low, data; read: address bytes then a separate read transaction); PID 0x3660 in read-only 0x300A/0x300B; software reset via 0x3008 bit 7; DVP output size from 0x3808-0x380b published to LCD_CAM and latched at CAM_START
implementation.guest_scan: guest I2C scan on GPIO12/9 sees 0x10/0x3c/0x68 (OV3660 at 0x3c) in both UIFlow2 and the community demo

stream.enable_path: console matrix sets QOM /machine/m5-lcd-cam auto-increment=true after the guest prints M12_BASE_DONE (no frame data injected)

community_demo.purpose: second, independent firmware path for the OV3660 control plane; downloaded and verified, run black-box

provenance.padded_flash_image_note: the sparse merged image is padded to the declared 8 MiB flash with 0xFF; the demo app writes NVS during boot, so the working copy mutates after a run and must be regenerated from this SHA-verified sparse image

run_markers: bmi270 init ok / bmm150 init ok / ir init
camera: Camera PID=0x3660 VER=0x00 MIDL=0x00 MIDH=0x00
usb_webcam: Selected Camera Board M5STACK AtomS3R-CAM

observed_limits.note: the demo selects an MJPEG UVC pipeline; the LCD_CAM model emits the deterministic RGB565 DVP waveform used by the UIFlow2 path and has no JPEG encoder, so cam_hal reports NO-SOI and the app restarts itself (rst:0x3 RTC_SW_SYS_RST). Full community-demo application, UVC and web-server behavior are NOT RUN.

not_run: physical optics/lens/exposure and DVP/SCCB electrical timing or drive strength
the community usb_webcam MJPEG/UVC data plane, UVC enumeration and web server behaviour
dynamic framesize changes while frames are streaming and sizes above the OV3660 driver maximum
IR GPIO47 transmit/receive data plane, Grove G2/G1 Units, USB CDC console
arbitrary third-party firmware and hardware validation
